text:
Lina: quick sync - ACME asked to guarantee burst capacity and remove softcap grace for Premium in their pilot. they want it asap. do we change tier or ship as an addon?
Ajay: my vote: ship as addon (surge-reserve). less invasive, easier to pilot, keeps existing Premium SLA intact.
Maria: +1 addon. but we must nail billing semantics and a clear rollback/soft-exit policy. last time billing edge cases burned ops.
Tom: finance note: need proration rules. options: bill for reserved tokens up-front monthly, or bill incremental based on usage. i prefer reserved + overage to lock revenue.
Lina: agreed reserved + overage. propose 14d soft-exit window (customer can drop reserve without penalty within 14 days).
Ajay: 14d sounds fair. ops: can we tag traffic for priority routing when addon is active? need fallback if pool fills.
ops-bot: autoscale alert: current autoscaler cannot isolate a dedicated surge pool. OPS action: create policy "surge_reserve_pool" and fallback -> route to best-effort cluster. opened INF-4921.
Maria: launch checklist draft:
- product spec (routes, tags, limits)
- docs + pricing snippet
- billing: reserved tokens accounting + proration rules
- telemetry: reserved vs used, per-customer latency and error rates
- ops playbook: pool exhaustion & degrade path
- legal addendum: watertight soft-exit clause
Tom: pilot commercial terms: 30% discount first 3 months, cap vendor exposure at $50k per customer. finance ok if cap enforced.
Lina: decision (tentative): addon "surge_reserve", reserved_tokens + overage billing, 14d soft-exit, pilot 30% off w/ $50k exposure cap.
Ajay: followups for sales: template SOW language, negotiation FAQ, how this interacts with Dedicated customers.
Maria: eng asks: sample config to implement ->
```yaml
addon: surge_reserve
reserved_tokens: 1000000
priority_tag: surge_reserve_customer
fallback: best_effort_pool
```
Tom: legal: can we get a 24hr turnaround on addendum draft? this customer is strategic.
LegalBot: acknowledged. we'll aim for draft within 48 hours. include termination & liability carveouts.
Lina: next steps: i'll write the PRD + sample pricing page. Ajay will prep sales comms. Ops/Eng to estimate work for INF-4921. Legal to draft addendum.
ops-bot: INF-4921 assigned to @ops-squad. ETA preliminary estimate by EOD Friday.
Lina: thanks team. ping me for signoff tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
